dsa_problems.title: Two Sum
dsa_problems.description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target.
misconception_traps: Using a nested loop (O(n^2)) instead of a hash map (O(n)).
Not handling duplicate values correctly if trying to sort first.

dsa_problems.title: Valid Palindrome
dsa_problems.description: A phrase is a palindrome if, after converting all uppercase letters into lowercase letters and removing all non-alphanumeric characters, it reads the same forward and backward.
misconception_traps: Creating a new reversed string instead of comparing in-place to save space (O(n) vs O(1) space).
Failing to handle empty strings or strings with only non-alphanumeric characters.

dsa_problems.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
dsa_problems.description: You are given an array prices where prices[i] is the price of a given stock on the ith day. You want to maximize your profit by choosing a single day to buy one stock and choosing a different day in the future to sell that stock.
misconception_traps: Finding max and min of the array without considering the order (must buy before sell).
Updating the minimum price at the wrong step.

dsa_problems.title: Valid Anagram
dsa_problems.description: Given two strings s and t, return true if t is an anagram of s, and false otherwise.
misconception_traps: Sorting both strings (O(n log n)) instead of using a character frequency map (O(n)).
Failing to check if lengths are different before iterating.

dsa_problems.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
dsa_problems.description: Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.
misconception_traps: Resetting the left pointer to left+1 and clearing the set instead of just removing characters until the duplicate is gone.

system_design_scenarios.title: Design a URL Shortener API
system_design_scenarios.description: Design the REST API endpoints and data model for a URL shortener service like bit.ly.
misconception_traps: Using GET for URL creation instead of POST.
Exposing internal database auto-increment IDs in the shortened URL instead of a Base62 encoded hash.

system_design_scenarios.title: Cache User Profiles
system_design_scenarios.description: Design a caching strategy for frequently accessed user profiles in a social media app using Redis.
misconception_traps: Not setting a TTL (Time To Live), leading to unbounded memory growth and stale data.
Cache stampede/dogpile effect when a popular profile expires and multiple requests hit the database simultaneously.

system_design_scenarios.title: Rate Limiter
system_design_scenarios.description: Design a rate limiting API middleware that limits users to 100 requests per minute.
misconception_traps: Using an in-memory counter per server in a distributed environment instead of a centralized store like Redis.
Failing to handle race conditions during counter increments (not using atomic operations or Redis INCR).
